scripts.dev: npm run sync:assets && concurrently -n gateway,landing,app,backend -c magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:landing" "npm run dev:app" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: uv run --project backend python backend/manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8000
scripts.build: npm run sync:assets && npm --workspace @mycelium/config run build && npm --workspace @mycelium/landing run build && npm --workspace @mycelium/app run build
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @mycelium/landing run lint && npm --workspace @mycelium/app run lint
scripts.build:landing: npm run sync:assets && npm --workspace @mycelium/landing exec -- astro build
